```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    title      TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
    body       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at TEXT    NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tags (
    id   INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 30),
    CONSTRAINT uq_tags_name UNIQUE (name)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS note_tags (
    note_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    tag_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (note_id, tag_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (note_id) REFERENCES notes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (tag_id)  REFERENCES tags (id)  ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_note_tags_tag_id ON note_tags (tag_id);
```

```python
import os
import re
import sqlite3
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Optional

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Response
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

SCHEMA_PATH = Path(__file__).with_name("schema.sql")
TAG_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9]{1,30}")
TITLE_MAX = 120


def db_path() -> str:
    return os.environ.get("NOTES_DB", "notes.db")


def get_conn() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path())
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    return conn


def init_db() -> None:
    schema = SCHEMA_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    conn = get_conn()
    try:
        conn.executescript(schema)
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(_app: FastAPI):
    init_db()
    yield


app = FastAPI(title="Notes service", lifespan=lifespan)


class NoteIn(BaseModel):
    title: str
    body: str = ""
    tags: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


def now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")


def validate_note(note: NoteIn) -> List[str]:
    if len(note.title) < 1 or len(note.title) > TITLE_MAX:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail="title must be between 1 and 120 characters",
        )
    tags: List[str] = []
    for tag in note.tags:
        if not isinstance(tag, str) or TAG_RE.fullmatch(tag) is None:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=422,
                detail=f"invalid tag: {tag!r}; tags must be 1 to 30 lowercase letters or digits",
            )
        if tag not in tags:
            tags.append(tag)
    return tags


def tags_for(conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int) -> List[str]:
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT t.name FROM tags t "
        "JOIN note_tags nt ON nt.tag_id = t.id "
        "WHERE nt.note_id = ? ORDER BY t.name",
        (note_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    return [r["name"] for r in rows]


def row_to_note(conn: sqlite3.Connection, row: sqlite3.Row) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": row["id"],
        "title": row["title"],
        "body": row["body"],
        "created_at": row["created_at"],
        "tags": tags_for(conn, row["id"]),
    }


def fetch_note(conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int) -> Optional[dict]:
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, body, created_at FROM notes WHERE id = ?",
        (note_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return row_to_note(conn, row)


@app.post("/notes", status_code=201)
def create_note(note: NoteIn) -> dict:
    tags = validate_note(note)
    conn = get_conn()
    try:
        with conn:
            cur = conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO notes (title, body, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                (note.title, note.body, now_iso()),
            )
            note_id = cur.lastrowid
            for tag in tags:
                conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO tags (name) VALUES (?)", (tag,))
                tag_id = conn.execute(
                    "SELECT id FROM tags WHERE name = ?", (tag,)
                ).fetchone()["id"]
                conn.execute(
                    "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO note_tags (note_id, tag_id) VALUES (?, ?)",
                    (note_id, tag_id),
                )
        return fetch_note(conn, note_id)
    finally:
        conn.close()


@app.get("/notes/{note_id}")
def get_note(note_id: int) -> dict:
    conn = get_conn()
    try:
        note = fetch_note(conn, note_id)
    finally:
        conn.close()
    if note is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="note not found")
    return note


@app.get("/notes")
def list_notes(tag: Optional[str] = None) -> List[dict]:
    conn = get_conn()
    try:
        if tag is None:
            rows = conn.execute(
                "SELECT id, title, body, created_at FROM notes "
                "ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC"
            ).fetchall()
        else:
            rows = conn.execute(
                "SELECT n.id, n.title, n.body, n.created_at FROM notes n "
                "JOIN note_tags nt ON nt.note_id = n.id "
                "JOIN tags t ON t.id = nt.tag_id "
                "WHERE t.name = ? "
                "ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC",
                (tag,),
            ).fetchall()
        return [row_to_note(conn, r) for r in rows]
    finally:
        conn.close()


@app.delete("/notes/{note_id}", status_code=204)
def delete_note(note_id: int) -> Response:
    conn = get_conn()
    try:
        with conn:
            exists = conn.execute(
                "SELECT 1 FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if exists is None:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="note not found")
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM note_tags WHERE note_id = ?", (note_id,))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,))
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return Response(status_code=204)
```

```python
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app import app


@pytest.fixture
def client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("NOTES_DB", str(tmp_path / "test_notes.db"))
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        yield c


def create(client, title="A note", body="text", tags=None):
    return client.post(
        "/notes", json={"title": title, "body": body, "tags": tags or []}
    )


def test_create_note(client):
    resp = create(client, title="Hello", body="World", tags=["work", "todo"])
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    data = resp.json()
    assert isinstance(data["id"], int)
    assert data["title"] == "Hello"
    assert data["body"] == "World"
    assert sorted(data["tags"]) == ["todo", "work"]
    assert data["created_at"].endswith("Z")


def test_create_with_empty_body_and_no_tags(client):
    resp = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "Only title"})
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    data = resp.json()
    assert data["body"] == ""
    assert data["tags"] == []


def test_get_note(client):
    note_id = create(client, title="Get me", tags=["x1"]).json()["id"]
    resp = client.get(f"/notes/{note_id}")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    data = resp.json()
    assert data["id"] == note_id
    assert data["title"] == "Get me"
    assert data["tags"] == ["x1"]


def test_get_missing_note_returns_404(client):
    assert client.get("/notes/9999").status_code == 404


def test_list_all_newest_first(client):
    first = create(client, title="first").json()["id"]
    second = create(client, title="second").json()["id"]
    third = create(client, title="third").json()["id"]
    resp = client.get("/notes")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert [n["id"] for n in resp.json()] == [third, second, first]


def test_list_by_tag(client):
    a = create(client, title="a", tags=["work"]).json()["id"]
    create(client, title="b", tags=["home"])
    c = create(client, title="c", tags=["work", "home"]).json()["id"]
    resp = client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "work"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert [n["id"] for n in resp.json()] == [c, a]
    assert client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "nothing"}).json() == []


def test_tags_are_shared_between_notes(client):
    create(client, title="one", tags=["shared"])
    create(client, title="two", tags=["shared"])
    resp = client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "shared"})
    assert len(resp.json()) == 2


def test_delete_note(client):
    note_id = create(client, title="to delete", tags=["gone"]).json()["id"]
    resp = client.delete(f"/notes/{note_id}")
    assert resp.status_code == 204
    assert client.get(f"/notes/{note_id}").status_code == 404
    assert client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "gone"}).json() == []


def test_delete_missing_note_returns_404(client):
    assert client.delete("/notes/9999").status_code == 404


def test_empty_title_returns_422(client):
    assert create(client, title="").status_code == 422


def test_too_long_title_returns_422(client):
    assert create(client, title="x" * 121).status_code == 422


def test_max_length_title_is_accepted(client):
    assert create(client, title="x" * 120).status_code == 201


def test_missing_title_returns_422(client):
    assert client.post("/notes", json={"body": "no title"}).status_code == 422


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad_tag", ["Work", "two words", "dash-tag", "", "a" * 31])
def test_invalid_tag_returns_422(client, bad_tag):
    assert create(client, tags=[bad_tag]).status_code == 422


def test_max_length_tag_is_accepted(client):
    assert create(client, tags=["a" * 30]).status_code == 201
```
